name: Duchess
timbre: hoarse, gravelly, heavy older woman's voice with a rough growl at the bottom; turns thick and syrupy when ingratiating
pitch: low contralto, chesty, sinking to a growl
accent: upper-class English drawl roughened by coarse habits, broad vowels, careless consonants
reference_style: Two modes: savage and barking in her pepper-filled kitchen ('Pig!', 'chop off her head!'), then cloying and over-close at the croquet-ground, attaching a 'moral' to everything; the voice dies to a thin whisper the moment the Queen appears. Sings the lullaby rough and rhythmic, with the 'Wow! wow! wow!' chorus.
